# OTHO Realty — Real Estate. With a clearer perspective.

> Hyderabad's premier independent real estate advisory. We provide fiduciary-grade project intelligence, transparent analysis, and advisory services for discerning property seekers in West Hyderabad.

## About OTHO
OTHO Realty is an independent real estate advisory firm headquartered in Kokapet, Hyderabad. We are not a brokerage — we are a research-led advisory. Our mandate is to protect capital, surface asymmetry, and deliver intelligence that the market conceals behind brochure language.

## Core Commitments
1. Your Number Is Never Shared — Zero broker spam. Enquiries stay with senior research principals.
2. We Publish The Negatives — Every project review includes honest drawbacks.
3. Checked Against Telangana RERA — All data vetted against statutory TG-RERA filings.
